hook.name: SpudsHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook managing four SPUDS/counter-asset pools with a block-based emission schedule. Distributes SPUDS token rewards to full-range LP positions and single-asset stakers proportionally, and allows anyone to trigger periodic buyback-and-burn of SPUDS using accumulated swap fees from the hook-owned genesis liquidity position.
